title: Loan & Liquidity Copilot: sell or borrow against Bitcoin | Virtuse
description: Compare selling Bitcoin with a Bitcoin-backed loan: tax, interest, liquidation price and what is left in five price scenarios. Not financial advice.
og_title: Loan & Liquidity Copilot: sell or borrow against Bitcoin
lead: Enter the cash you need and the Bitcoin you hold. You see the tax on a sale, the cost of a loan, the price at which a loan gets into trouble and what is left in five price scenarios.
noscript: Loan & Liquidity Copilot needs JavaScript. You can read the sell or borrow guide instead.
s1_p: The cash you need, the Bitcoin you hold, the loan terms and your tax country.
s2_p: Selling costs tax now. Borrowing costs interest and can be liquidated if the price falls.
s3_p: Five price paths show what is left of your Bitcoin either way. Both columns assume you spend the cash.
a1: If the Bitcoin price falls far enough, the lender can sell part or all of your collateral to repay the loan. You can lose Bitcoin you pledged.
q2: Where do the tax rates come from?
a2: Each country shows the rate with a link to the official source and the date we checked it. Holding-period exemptions are noted. It is not tax advice.
a3: That depends on the lender. Check the lender's own terms before you pledge Bitcoin.
a4: No. It is a calculator for your own numbers. It does not tell you whether to sell or borrow.
rel_stack_p: Plan an amount and a rhythm.
rel_cfo_p: Test a decision for free; the CFO then tracks fees and risks.
disclaimer: A Bitcoin-backed loan can be liquidated if the price falls. Not financial, tax or legal advice. Virtuse never holds your keys or funds.
